name: Eddy Ospina
bio:
Eddy Ospina is a professional tattoo artist based in the vibrant South Beach area of Miami Beach, United States, specializing in custom design tattoos that cater to the unique visions of their clients. Known for maintaining an exceptional level of cleanliness in their practice, Eddy can be found at the esteemed Miami Ink Love Hate studio on Tuesdays, Fridays, and Sundays. Clients appreciate the sterile and hygienic environment, which ensures both safety and comfort during the tattooing process.
